dataPractices.category: Tasks, plans, execution records, achievements and wellbeing entries
dataPractices.handling: Stored in the app's local SQLite database; not sent to a model provider in the current build.
Read only after permission, bounded to selected calendars, and cached locally without external event titles, notes, locations or attendees.
Created only after permission and explicit plan commit; the app does not silently modify third-party calendar events.
No production model provider is configured. Future user credentials must use SecureStore and require a new privacy review.

storeCopy.zh-CN: 任务、计划、执行记录、成就、复盘、精力记录与放松记录默认保存在设备本地。经你授权后，应用只读取所选日历的忙闲时间，并仅维护本应用创建的日历事件与提醒。当前版本未启用云同步、远程模型、生产 OTA、应用层数据库加密或用户导出/恢复，因此不会对这些能力作出承诺。
storeCopy.en-US: Tasks, plans, execution records, achievements, reflections, energy check-ins, and relax sessions are stored locally on the device by default. With permission, the app reads bounded busy times from selected calendars and maintains only calendar events and reminders created by this app. This build does not enable cloud sync, a remote model provider, production OTA, app-layer database encryption, or user export and restore, and makes no promise that those capabilities are available.
